title: Echoes of the Council | ECHO//100 Episode 83
description: Kavi confronts a council of his own past selves to prevent the ultimate reset of reality. He must prove his individuality before the timeline collapses entirely. Episode 83 of ECHO//100: The Door War. This is an AI-assisted original fiction production.

scenes.text: Gravity releases as shadows detach from gears, coalescing into six hooded Kavi figures.
scenes.caption: Council of Kavis appears
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of Kavi in his red hoodie standing on a massive clock face, surrounded by six identical shadowy figures in tattered clothing.

scenes.text: The Council speaks in unison, demanding Kavi’s erasure to stabilize the fracturing, dying reality.
scenes.caption: Council demands erasure
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking up at the six shadowy Kavis, their faces obscured by dark mist while glowing eyes stare down.

scenes.text: Byte struggles against the mainframe, her cyan face flickering as the Council votes reset.
scenes.caption: Byte trapped in mainframe
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a floating white robot with an orange antenna, struggling as glowing cables wrap around her body.

scenes.text: The Council claims Kavi’s singular existence is the contagion preventing the universe from resetting.
scenes.caption: Kavi is the contagion
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of a Council member pointing a finger at Kavi, whose expression is one of desperate defiance.

scenes.text: Kavi seeks a memory never held by them, a truth buried within a fractured mind.
scenes.caption: Searching for lost memories
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi clutching his backpack straps, eyes closed as golden light emanates from his glasses.

scenes.text: Kavi projects a broken phone memory, forcing the Council to recoil from unfamiliar pain.
scenes.caption: The phone memory revealed
scenes.image_prompt: A holographic projection of a shattered smartphone floating between Kavi and the shocked Council members.

scenes.text: Individuality breaks the cycle, causing the Council to dissolve into blinding, searing geometric light.
scenes.caption: Council begins to disintegrate
scenes.image_prompt: The shadowy figures turning into bright, pixelated light particles, leaving Kavi standing alone in the center.

scenes.text: They vanish, leaving only a glowing red shard of the original doorway in Kavi’s hand.
scenes.caption: Red shard remains
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi holding a jagged, glowing red crystal shard, the Clock Tower chamber dark and silent behind him.
